name: stat-card
title: Stat Card
description: A KPI tile in the rig3 style — label, uppercase tag, a light figure with its unit, the change with a trend glyph, a sparkline and a one-line description; `density="compact"` for a KPI strip. Direction and sentiment are separate inputs, because at an oil company 'up' is not always good.
docs: Set `intent` explicitly: 'higher-is-better' (production, uptime), 'lower-is-better' (flaring, emissions, downtime, water cut). Defaults to 'neutral' — an honest grey delta beats a confident wrong colour. `trend` takes the recent series oldest-first.
